name: ultrapolish
description: Two universal design-polish skills by James Frewin. They take any app from 6/10 to 11/10 on detail, UX and cohesion, inside its own visual style.

plugins.name: ultrapolish
plugins.description: ultrapolish-ios (Swift/SwiftUI) and ultrapolish-web (React/TypeScript/CSS): motion, colour, typography, layout, sheets, haptics, sound, buttons, icons, copy, states, onboarding, paywalls, widgets, accessibility. Style-agnostic: reads your tokens first, never introduces a palette or a typeface.
